description.zh: 备份计划ID，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: Backup plan ID. Obtain this parameter's value by calling the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) API.

description.zh:
备份数据保留时间，单位为天，取值：0~1825。

> 默认为730（天）。
description.en:
Backup data retention period, in days. Valid values: 0 to 1825.

> Default value: 730 days.

description.zh: 任意字符串，用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。
description.en: An arbitrary string used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions.

description.zh:
转为归档冷备存储时间。需要小于备份数据保留时间（BackupRetentionPeriod参数）。更多关于归档存储的说明，请参见[存储类型介绍](~~51374~~)。
> 默认为365（天）。
description.en:
Time to convert to Archive Storage. This value must be less than the backup data retention period (BackupRetentionPeriod parameter). For more information about Archive Storage, see [Storage Type Overview](~~51374~~).

> Default value: 365 days.

description.zh:
转为低频访问存储时间。需要小于归档冷备存储时间（DuplicationArchivePeriod参数）。更多关于低频访问存储的说明，请参见[存储类型介绍](~~51374~~)。
> 默认为180（天）。
description.en:
Time to convert to Infrequent Access storage. This value must be less than the Archive Storage period (DuplicationArchivePeriod parameter). For more information about Infrequent Access storage, see [Storage Type Overview](~~51374~~).

> Default value: 180 days.

title.zh: 修改存储数据的生命周期

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dbs modify-storage-strategy --backup-plan-id dbsqdss5tmh0000 --backup-retention-period 730 --duplication-infrequent-access-period 190 --duplication-archive-period 366 --client-token dbstest --increment-backup-retention-period 365 --increment-duplication-infrequent-access-period 365 --increment-duplication-archive-period 365 --log-backup-retention-period 365 --log-duplication-infrequent-access-period 365 --log-duplication-archive-period 365 --backup-storage-encrypt-method encrypted --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dbs ModifyStorageStrategy --region cn-hangzhou --DuplicationArchivePeriod 366 --IncrementDuplicationArchivePeriod 365 --LogBackupRetentionPeriod 365 --LogDuplicationInfrequentAccessPeriod 365 --IncrementBackupRetentionPeriod 365 --BackupStorageEncryptMethod encrypted --IncrementDuplicationInfrequentAccessPeriod 365 --BackupPlanId dbsqdss5tmh0000 --BackupRetentionPeriod 730 --LogDuplicationArchivePeriod 365 --ClientToken dbstest --DuplicationInfrequentAccessPeriod 190
